summary: Iteration-2 testing complete for M365 Migration Suite. Backend: 42/42 pytest cases passing (29 iter1 regression + 13 new iter2 tests) covering Graph adapter simulated fallback, preflight, discovery mode, concurrent runner performance, notification pipeline log entries, PUT /notifications persistence, CSV+PDF report endpoints, and retry-failed correctness. Frontend: full flow verified via Playwright — login -> create project (with notification settings) -> preflight modal (all 5 checks with 'PASS' overall) -> activate project -> discover exchange (simulated badge shown) -> set concurrency=5 -> start migration -> job detail with CSV/PDF download buttons produce real downloads via authenticated blob fetch.

issues: Layout & contrast are good; overall/status chips render with clear color coding (green=pass, amber=warn, red=fail, cyan=info). Modal closes cleanly on X click.

action_items: No blocking action items. All iteration-2 features working as designed.
Optional: Concurrent job with 8 items @ concurrency=4 completes in ~2.5s in tests. Consider adding a metric log for the runner throughput for future observability.

Optional (dev-only): Preview environment editor instrumentation injects <span> nodes inside <option> tags in ServiceModule.jsx (concurrency select) causing a React hydration warning — this is NOT in the source code; it's from the preview tooling. Ignorable, but if seen in prod, verify no <span> is inside <option> after build.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:329-343 — preflight silently uses random.uniform for storage_free_tb even in the 'live' path (comment acknowledges it 'requires reports API'). Consider labelling the storage headroom check status='info' when the value is simulated so operators don't mistake random numbers for real telemetry.

server.py:378 — random.seed(hash(...)) uses hash() which is process-salted for strings in Python 3 (PYTHONHASHSEED); discovery counts are still deterministic per-request but IDs across processes may drift. Consider hashlib.md5 for cross-process determinism.

graph_adapter.py:99 — 429 handling raises GraphError to trigger tenacity retry, but also does an inline asyncio.sleep(retry_after) BEFORE raising. Combined with tenacity's wait_exponential, effective backoff is roughly (retry_after + exp). Not a bug but worth documenting.

notifier.py:113 — when settings.email_provider is empty AND recipient is set, it falls back to EMAIL_PROVIDER env. If both empty, send_email hits 'unknown provider' path. Consider skipping the send entirely when no provider AND env fallback is empty, to avoid the noisy warn log.

JobDetail.jsx:60-90 — CSV/PDF download uses a raw fetch() with Authorization header pulled from localStorage. If the user cleared localStorage but still has an httpOnly cookie, the fetch will fail with 401. Consider omitting the manual Authorization header when 'mm_token' is null (rely on credentials:'include' cookie).
server.py:610-635 retry_failed now correctly preserves successes (matches iter1 review comment). Retry sets completed_count = success_count so progress shows correctly during retry — clean fix.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Iter2_* projects, TEST_Notif_* project (with notification_settings including bad webhook to exercise warn log path), and TEST_UI_Iter2_* project via UI. Multiple exchange jobs created and completed. All prefixed TEST_ for cleanup.

Run via: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v. Total runtime ~26s. Both use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env. Frontend flow tested via Playwright: login -> Projects (preflight modal) -> ServiceModule (concurrency + live/sim badge) -> JobDetail (CSV/PDF blob download via authenticated fetch). Notification pipeline validated: with empty RESEND/SENDGRID keys the notifier returns {ok:false, error:'...KEY not set'} and produces a warn-level log entry starting with 'notification :: ' — this is the intended design per problem statement.
